items.title: File Widerspruch against Kinderzuschlag rejection
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Familienkasse Muster-Mitte, Postfach 44 01, 34002 Neu-Musterdorf, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 21.11.2025 and presumed posted same day. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a notice sent by post is deemed delivered on the third day after posting, i.e. 21.11.2025 + 3 days = 24.11.2025 (Monday); this day is not a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday, so Bekanntgabe = 24.11.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period runs from this date: under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of notification itself is not counted, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period defined in months ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. the 24th. One month after 24.11.2025 is 24.12.2025 (Wednesday). 24 December is not a statutory public holiday in NRW, so the deadline stands.
